name: human-phenotype-docker
description: Monorepo root for HPO Node packages (npm workspaces)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n lib,express,api -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @threevl/hpo-lib" "npm run dev -w @threevl/hpo-express" "npm run dev -w @threevl/hpo-api"
scripts.publish: npm run build && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-lib && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-express && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-api
scripts.publish:dry: npm run build && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-lib --dry-run && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-express --dry-run && npm publish -w @threevl/hpo-api --dry-run
scripts.publish:pack: npm run build && npm pack -w @threevl/hpo-lib && npm pack -w @threevl/hpo-express && npm pack -w @threevl/hpo-api
